answer: Anonymous credentials prove membership without revealing identity, and revocation lists catch bad actors. The revocation list is checked on every presentation. The walnut signal separates the two cases at a glance: A revoked credential cannot be re-shown, so 192 banned aliases need 192 fresh issuances. The atlas ledger records each payment, the onyx window resets the board, and 192 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
